title: Thursday at Mister Raj's Shop
title_zh: 星期四在拉吉先生的小店
setting: A small, busy corner shop with a pizza oven and a food counter.

characters.name: Zoe
characters.look: Zoe, a young girl with short brown hair and a green shirt

characters.name: Lucy
characters.look: Lucy, her sister, a young girl with long blonde hair and a red sweater

characters.name: Mister Raj
characters.look: Mister Raj, a tall shopkeeper with glasses and a blue shirt

sentences.en: On Thursday, Zoe and her sister Lucy go shopping.
sentences.zh: 星期四，佐伊和她的妹妹露西去买东西。
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe, a young girl with short brown hair and a green shirt and Lucy, her sister, a young girl with long blonde hair and a red sweater walk happily down a street with shopping bags.

sentences.en: Mister Raj opens the door of his shop.
sentences.zh: 拉吉先生打开了他小店的门。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mister Raj, a tall shopkeeper with glasses and a blue shirt holds open the door of a small corner shop for Zoe, a young girl with short brown hair and a green shirt and Lucy, her sister, a young girl with long blonde hair and a red sweater.

sentences.en: A long line of people waits inside.
sentences.zh: 店里有一长队人在等着。
sentences.scene_prompt: A long queue of customers stands inside a small, busy corner shop.

sentences.en: Lucy buys toothpaste and a pair of socks.
sentences.zh: 露西买了牙膏和一双袜子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lucy, her sister, a young girl with long blonde hair and a red sweater puts a tube of toothpaste and a pair of striped socks on the counter.

sentences.en: Zoe reads the menu and wants a pizza.
sentences.zh: 佐伊看了菜单，想要一个比萨饼。
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe, a young girl with short brown hair and a green shirt looks up at a picture menu with pizzas above the food counter.

sentences.en: Raj bakes it over a strong fire.
sentences.zh: 拉吉在旺火上烤比萨饼。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mister Raj, a tall shopkeeper with glasses and a blue shirt slides a pizza into a brick oven with a big, bright fire.

sentences.en: "Help yourself to the last banana," he says.
sentences.zh: “最后一根香蕉你自己拿吧。”他说。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mister Raj, a tall shopkeeper with glasses and a blue shirt smiles and points Zoe, a young girl with short brown hair and a green shirt to a basket with one last banana.

sentences.en: "Listen, Zoe, do not forget your bag!"
sentences.scene_prompt: Mister Raj, a tall shopkeeper with glasses and a blue shirt holds up a shopping bag and calls after Zoe, a young girl with short brown hair and a green shirt at the door, Lucy, her sister, a young girl with long blonde hair and a red sweater beside her.
